##### Project general facts

Mansory Residences by Amaal is a groundbreaking collaboration between Amaal Emirates and Mansory, the legendary name in supercar customisation, bringing performance-inspired design into luxury living. Two towers rise above a shared ground floor and eight podium levels, one to forty-one residential floors and the other to forty-nine, topped by amenity rooftops. Aerodynamic contours, carbon-inspired accents and contrasting materials express the brand's style. The project offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, including four-bedroom duplexes.

Amenities blend wellness, leisure and the brand's automotive heritage. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, a gym and beauty space, a spa with indoor and outdoor massage areas, a steam room and a sauna. An indoor cinema, a padel court, mini golf, a kids' play area and a pet park add variety for all ages, while the Mansory Cafe and Bar, a Mansory boutique and a curated auto lounge with concierge car care complete a distinctive lifestyle offer.

Interiors are crafted with meticulous attention to detail and high-quality materials, where every line, texture and surface evokes both strength and elegance. Spacious layouts are designed for comfort, with living areas framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and city views. Butler and concierge services, in-residence dining, housekeeping and a residents' app deliver effortless everyday living. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Ras Al Khor is a central district of Dubai set beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, known for its flamingos and protected wetlands at the end of Dubai Creek. The area is evolving into a residential and lifestyle destination close to Dubai Creek Harbour, Meydan and Dubai Design District, combining green surroundings with quick access to the city centre.

Dubai Design District is a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and The Dubai Mall are easily reached. Dubai International Financial Centre and Meydan Racecourse are close by, and Al Khail Road, Ras Al Khor Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city and neighbouring emirates, while schools, clinics and supermarkets are found across the surrounding districts.

Ras Al Khor is a freehold area attracting buyers seeking branded residences close to Downtown Dubai at accessible entry points. Branded towers inspired by an internationally recognised luxury name are in limited supply, supporting demand from investors and premium tenants. Central connectivity, green surroundings and the continued transformation of the neighbouring districts underpin long-term value and resale prospects for owners and investors.
